restaurants.name: The Herbfarm
restaurants.note: Iconic multi-course, farm-to-table tasting menu paired with Northwest wines. Reservations essential, well ahead.

restaurants.name: Barking Frog
restaurants.note: Award-winning wine list and Northwest bistro fare at Willows Lodge.

restaurants.name: The Restaurant at DeLille Cellars
restaurants.note: Wine-centric dining with house-made pasta, in the former Redhook Brewery space.

restaurants.name: Purple Café and Wine Bar
restaurants.note: Woodinville original — big wine-by-the-glass list, PNW comfort food.

restaurants.name: Heritage Restaurant | Bar
restaurants.note: Community hub at the Hollywood Hill roundabout — approachable, moderately priced, good for date night or families.

restaurants.name: Pintxo by Valdemar
restaurants.note: Basque-inspired tapas and Spanish-and-Washington wine pairings at Valdemar Estates.

restaurants.name: Molbak's Garden Café
restaurants.note: Casual soups, salads, sandwiches, and pastries surrounded by greenery.

restaurants.name: Bin 47
restaurants.note: Seasonal Northwest fare at The SOMM Hotel & Spa.

restaurants.name: The Shed
restaurants.note: Rooftop bar at The SOMM with panoramic Mt. Rainier views — craft brews and spirits.

restaurants.name: Woodinville Cut Shop
restaurants.note: American roadhouse — smoked meats, sandwiches, beer garden with a fire pit and live music some nights.

restaurants.name: Woodinville Whiskey Co.
restaurants.note: Distillery tasting room and tours — bourbon, rye, and cocktails rather than wine.

restaurants.name: Rooney's Sports Bar
restaurants.note: Sports bar — game-day food and a big beer/spirits selection.

restaurants.name: Von's 1000° Spirits
restaurants.note: Whiskey-and-cocktail-forward bar with a wide spirits list.

restaurants.name: Pour Decisions Taps
restaurants.note: Self-serve taproom — pour-your-own beer and cider flights.

restaurants.name: Brix Wine Café
restaurants.note: Wine café — light bites and a curated by-the-glass list.

restaurants.name: Hollywood Schoolhouse Bistro
restaurants.note: Bistro fare in the Hollywood Schoolhouse building.
